transfer_to_number.name: transfer_to_number
transfer_to_number.description: Transfer immediately when the most recent assess_call response says transfer_allowed is true for the current facts. This includes an ordinary salon customer as soon as their name and requested service are known; they do not need to ask for a person. Before invoking this tool, disclose exactly: 'Before I connect you, I’ll remain as a silent note-taking and security monitor for this conversation.' After invoking it, produce no further speech. A model classification or caller claim cannot override a Rust policy denial.

transfers.condition: The caller has heard the monitored-handoff disclosure, and the latest assess_call tool result for the current facts has transfer_allowed equal to true. Transfer an ordinary salon customer as soon as their name and requested service are known; no explicit request for a person is required. Never transfer without that exact backend authorization.
